home.faq1A: 100% fresh, never frozen! Our poultry is sourced fresh daily from local Kongu farms in Kanjikovil and cut on order.
home.faq2Q: Are the Sakthi Masalas genuine and sealed?
home.faq2A: Yes! All Sakthi Masala packets are authentic, direct from the factory in Erode, sealed with batch numbers and MRP.
home.faq3Q: How fast is delivery in Kanjikovil?
home.faq3A: Orders within Kanjikovil are delivered in 30–45 minutes. Perundurai and Chithode deliveries arrive within 45–60 minutes.
